raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add opt-in configuration, protocol and session handling for placing a speculator in a standalone process. This is the foundation of same-host remote draft placement.

Related design: [RFC #42109](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/42109). This is part 1/3 (foundation) of the standalone placement series.

## Claims

- Negotiate model/feature compatibility and inline byte budgets before sending tensors.
- Fence requests and proposal handles by session, sequence identity and generation.
- Support strict errors or terminal target-only fallback, with bounded connection, frame and pending-work resources.
- Preserve the original typed transport failure or deadline when socket cleanup also fails, so failure policy and terminal fencing still apply.

## Validation

Source: `0085c631c160cb47142457f5f812980e92ba1552`. Review base: `ded32c3ba7dd7e7acdf6f76f055e95847007a506`. [Incremental diff](https://github.com/seo-rii/vllm/compare/ded32c3ba7dd7e7acdf6f76f055e95847007a506...0085c631c160cb47142457f5f812980e92ba1552).

This corrective revision retains the existing PR boundaries. New results below cover only their named source and test selection; inherited coverage is labeled explicitly. Overlapping runs are not added together.

Foundation socket and session regressions: **175 passed, 0 skipped**, executed at `0085c631c160cb47142457f5f812980e92ba1552`. This run executed this exact PR head.

At original source `e888ffdb493c9b75e12df4612cf6d68e830d8086` with regression tests added, the cleanup selection reported `7 failed, 168 deselected`; after the fix it reported `7 passed, 168 deselected`. The selection is `-k 'cleanup_error or socket_cleanup_failure'` on these two files. The complete two-file result is shown above.

Actual socket faults exercise disconnects, send deadlines, malformed or partial frames, terminal fallback and a fresh request reconnect. Public-LLM serving validation is tracked separately.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -B -m pytest --noconftest -q tests/v1/spec_decode/remote/test_transport.py tests/v1/spec_decode/remote/test_session.py
```

Standalone MTP public-LLM socket cleanup and recovery: **1 passed, 0 skipped**, executed at `70b612c1a8fb489c841992ee4ad1126af4b4b9d3`. This is inherited coverage from the stated tested source; this result is not a separate execution of this PR head.

Executed on one A100 80GB with PyTorch 2.14.0+cu130. Tracked source and native-artifact hashes matched before and after execution; all owned workers retired.

The affected request finishes with exactly the target-only output and remains terminal with no extra remote RPCs or consumed drafts; a fresh request reconnects and consumes additional remote drafts.

Original production `1dbbf419a716325eb71eb38aff236eec60f24dbd` plus the regression tests (validation-only snapshot `535a0fc22fff812958bbfad332b6428a9d1685be`) reported `1 failed, 0 passed, 0 skipped` for the reported defect. RED command: `.venv/bin/python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -v -r s -s -p pytest_asyncio.plugin -p pytest_forked tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/remote/test_remote_mtp.py::test_remote_mtp_socket_cleanup_failure_preserves_target_only_and_reconnects`.

RED output: `RuntimeError: remote drafter proposal failed: OSError: [Errno 9] Bad file descriptor`. The GREEN regression completes without this failure.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -v -r s -s -p pytest_asyncio.plugin -p pytest_forked tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/remote/test_remote_mtp.py::test_remote_mtp_socket_cleanup_failure_preserves_target_only_and_reconnects
```

<details>
<summary>Previous-source validation before this corrective revision</summary>

The following results retain their original SHAs and hardware scope. They are historical evidence, not fresh executions of the source above.

Previously published source: `e888ffdb493c9b75e12df4612cf6d68e830d8086`. Review base: `ded32c3ba7dd7e7acdf6f76f055e95847007a506`. [Incremental diff](https://github.com/seo-rii/vllm/compare/ded32c3ba7dd7e7acdf6f76f055e95847007a506...e888ffdb493c9b75e12df4612cf6d68e830d8086).

The CPU/socket evidence below retains its original validation SHA.

<details>
<summary>Historical validation at the stated source revisions</summary>

These executions predate the assembled source above and do not substitute for current-source validation.

### Evidence from `e888ffdb493c9b75e12df4612cf6d68e830d8086` and earlier stated sources

CPU/socket suite at `925f653d3c`: **325 passed**. Real socket tests cover partial ACKs, disconnects, late replies, generation reuse, backpressure and retirement.

```bash
PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest --noconftest -q \
  tests/v1/spec_decode/remote/test_{capabilities,protocol,remote_config,server,session,state,transport}.py
```

</details>

</details>

## Details

The target retains native token verification and sampling. Requests whose remote state becomes uncertain remain terminal; reconnecting admits new identities. Native local execution remains the default, and `transport="auto"` selects inline.

The RFC author already published a [ZMQ-based disaggregated-drafting POC](https://github.com/laviier/vllm/tree/2132e0599aba8dd252b6e1880547c6617b709a2c). The POC includes a custom standalone draft runner; this series reuses native MRV2 speculators under explicit placement contracts. This increment proposes the capability, bounded-session and lifecycle foundation for that placement; it does not claim remote transport or N:M routing as new concepts. GPU execution and CUDA IPC are the next two increments. Predictive fan-out caching and cross-node execution remain outside this foundation.

AI assistance: Codex and Claude Code were used for implementation and testing. Human review of the final diff remains pending.

- [ ] **Design Fit:** Maintainer agreement on the runtime boundary and supported contracts.
- [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Review current-source validation, model evidence and remaining hardware gaps.
- [ ] **Code Quality and Style:** Human review of the final code and documentation.

@@ -0,0 +1,132 @@
+name: Fork remote CPU and lint
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+    paths:
+      - '.github/workflows/fork-remote-cpu.yml'
+      - '.github/workflows/scripts/*remote_cpu*'
+      - 'requirements/**'
+      - 'uv.lock'
+      - 'setup.py'
+      - 'setup.cfg'
+      - '.pre-commit-config.yaml'
+      - 'pyproject.toml'
+      - 'vllm/**'
+      - 'tests/**'
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - 'remote-speculator-*'
+      - 'feat/remote-*'
+      - 'feat/unified-speculation-runtime'
+    paths:
+      - '.github/workflows/fork-remote-cpu.yml'
+      - '.github/workflows/scripts/*remote_cpu*'
+      - 'requirements/**'
+      - 'uv.lock'
+      - 'setup.py'
+      - 'setup.cfg'
+      - '.pre-commit-config.yaml'
+      - 'pyproject.toml'
+      - 'vllm/**'
+      - 'tests/**'
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: fork-remote-cpu-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  cpu-and-lint:
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        suite: [control, native]
+    if: github.repository == 'seo-rii/vllm'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    env:
+      PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD: '1'
+      VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE: cpu
+      CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: ''
+      OMP_NUM_THREADS: '1'
+      MKL_NUM_THREADS: '1'
+      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: '1'
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 2
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@37802adc94f370d6bfd71619e3f0bf239e1f3b78 # v7.6.0
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.12'
+      - name: Install CPU test dependencies
+        run: |
+          uv venv --python 3.12 .venv
+          uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python \
+            pytest==8.4.2 pytest-timeout==2.4.0 msgspec==0.19.0 ruff==0.14.0 \
+            numpy==2.3.5 regex==2026.9.29
+          uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python \
+            torch==2.14.0+cpu torchvision==0.29.1+cpu \
+            --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
+      - name: Lint changed Python files
+        env:
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
+        run: |
+          .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
+          import os
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+
+          base = os.environ['BASE_SHA']
+          if not base or set(base) == {'0'}:
+              base = subprocess.check_output(
+                  ['git', 'hash-object', '-t', 'tree', '/dev/null'], text=True
+              ).strip()
+          elif subprocess.run(
+              ['git', 'cat-file', '-e', base + '^{commit}'],
+              stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+          ).returncode:
+              subprocess.run(
+                  ['git', 'fetch', '--no-tags', '--depth=1', 'origin', base],
+                  check=True,
+              )
+          files = [os.fsdecode(path) for path in subprocess.check_output([
+              'git', 'diff', '--name-only', '--diff-filter=ACMR', '-z',
+              base, 'HEAD', '--', '*.py',
+          ]).split(b'\0') if path]
+          if files:
+              subprocess.run([
+                  sys.executable, '-m', 'ruff', 'check',
+                  '--output-format=github', '--', *files,
+              ], check=True)
+              subprocess.run([
+                  sys.executable, '-m', 'ruff', 'format', '--check', '--', *files,
+              ], check=True)
+          else:
+              print('No changed Python files.')
+          PY
+      - name: Install native configuration and loader dependencies
+        run: |
+          uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python \
+            transformers==5.20.2 'pydantic>=2.12.0,<3' safetensors \
+            cachetools cloudpickle blake3 psutil py-cpuinfo pyzmq sentencepiece \
+            cbor2 einops requests aiohttp oss-harmony 'mcp>=2,<3' openai \
+            partial-json-parser pillow==12.3.0 compressed-tensors==0.17.0 depyf==0.20.0 \
+            opencv-python-headless 'fastapi>=0.133.0,<0.137.0' pybase64 \
+            uvloop prometheus-client xgrammar==0.2.8 'llguidance>=1.7,<1.8' \
+            tiktoken 'mistral-common[image]>=1.11.6'
+      - name: Test complete remote CPU suites
+        run: >-
+          .venv/bin/python .github/workflows/scripts/remote_cpu_regressions.py
+          --suite ${{ matrix.suite }}
+      - name: Upload selected nodes, collected count, and results
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
+        with:
+          name: remote-cpu-${{ matrix.suite }}-${{ github.sha }}
+          path: remote-cpu-results/
+          if-no-files-found: warn

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Run complete remote CPU suites and record the exact collected test cases."""
+
+import argparse
+import ast
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+NATIVE_SUITES = {
+    "test_gpu_runtime.py",
+    "test_mtp_contracts.py",
+    "test_remote_config.py",
+    "test_target_kv_runtime.py",
+    "test_token_gpu.py",
+}
+EXTERNAL_REGRESSIONS = {
+    "tests/v1/core/test_async_scheduler.py": (
+        "test_worker_invalid_drafts_follow_queued_step_and_grammar_union",
+    ),
+    "tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_input_batch_v2.py": (
+        "test_model_input_padding_preserves_logical_tokens",
+        "test_invalid_spec_tokens_use_current_packed_request_boundaries",
+    ),
+    "tests/v1/test_serial_utils.py": (
+        "test_model_runner_invalid_draft_metadata_round_trip",
+    ),
+}
+
+
+def regression_nodes(suite: str = "all", root: Path = Path(".")) -> list[str]:
+    tests = root / "tests/v1/spec_decode/remote"
+    nodes = [
+        str(path.relative_to(root))
+        for path in sorted(tests.glob("test_*.py"))
+        if suite == "all" or (path.name in NATIVE_SUITES) == (suite == "native")
+    ]
+    if suite != "native":
+        nodes.append(".github/workflows/scripts/test_remote_cpu_regressions.py")
+    if suite != "control":
+        for name, candidates in EXTERNAL_REGRESSIONS.items():
+            path = root / name
+            if path.is_file():
+                definitions = {
+                    node.name
+                    for node in ast.parse(path.read_text()).body
+                    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
+                }
+                nodes.extend(
+                    f"{name}::{test}" for test in candidates if test in definitions
+                )
+    return nodes
+
+
+class CollectionReport:
+    def __init__(self, path: Path, nodes: list[str], suite: str):
+        self.path = path
+        self.report = {
+            "suite": suite,
+            "revision": subprocess.check_output(
+                ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True
+            ).strip(),
+            "selected": nodes,
+            "collected": [],
+            "collected_count": 0,
+            "outcomes": {},
+        }
+        self.write()
+
+    def write(self):
+        self.path.write_text(json.dumps(self.report, indent=2) + "\n")
+
+    def pytest_collection_finish(self, session):
+        self.report["collected"] = [item.nodeid for item in session.items]
+        self.report["collected_count"] = len(session.items)
+        self.write()
+
+    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self, report):
+        if report.when == "call" or report.failed or report.skipped:
+            self.report["outcomes"][report.nodeid] = report.outcome
+
+    def pytest_sessionfinish(self, session, exitstatus):
+        self.report["exitstatus"] = int(exitstatus)
+        self.write()
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--list", action="store_true", help="Print selected pytest nodes"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--suite", choices=("all", "control", "native"), default="all")
+    parser.add_argument("--artifacts", type=Path, default=Path("remote-cpu-results"))
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    nodes = regression_nodes(args.suite)
+    if args.list:
+        print("\n".join(nodes))
+        return 0
+
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
+    import pytest
+
+    args.artifacts.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    report = CollectionReport(args.artifacts / "collection.json", nodes, args.suite)
+    if not nodes:
+        print(f"No {args.suite} suites exist on this branch.")
+        return 0
+    return int(
+        pytest.main(
+            [
+                "--noconftest",
+                "-p",
+                "pytest_timeout",
+                "--timeout=60",
+                "-q",
+                f"--junitxml={args.artifacts / 'junit.xml'}",
+                *nodes,
+            ],
+            plugins=[report],
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Guard the stacked-PR CPU gate against silently omitting complete suites."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from remote_cpu_regressions import EXTERNAL_REGRESSIONS, regression_nodes
+
+
+def test_every_remote_suite_is_selected_once_in_the_job_matrix():

+# Remote draft placement (experimental)
+
+Remote placement separates a target-conditioned speculator from the target
+process. The target remains responsible for verification and sampling. Placement
+is configured independently of the speculative method; native local execution
+remains the default.
+
+This foundation provides configuration, feature negotiation, bounded inline
+frames and request lifecycles. It deliberately rejects GPU serving until the
+standalone GPU runtime is installed. The protocol test adapter is for development,
+not a model-serving backend.
+
+## Configuration and lifecycle
+
+`speculative_config.remote_draft` takes a single `endpoint`, a `transport`
+(`auto` or `inline`) and a `failure_policy` (`target_only` or `error`). `auto`
+selects inline. Use a Unix socket or loopback TCP endpoint on the same host.
+The protocol does not authenticate peers; non-loopback server binding requires
+explicit `--allow-remote-connections`.
+
+The default request budget is 100 ms and the initial connection budget is
+30,000 ms. A request timeout under `target_only` permanently disables remote
+speculation for affected requests, returning zero valid drafts while the target
+continues. `error` surfaces the failure. Reconnection may admit new identities;
+it does not rebuild the old requests' draft KV. Generation and session fencing
+prevent late replies from reactivating retired state. Replies for another session,
+request, or batch are discarded before their ordering counters or draft tokens are
+used.
+
+Socket cleanup errors encountered while handling a transport failure do not
+replace that failure or interrupt the configured fallback.
+
+Feature schema and frame byte budgets are checked before tensor serialization.
+Connections, partial frames, pending bytes and adapter waiters have server-side
+bounds. A shutdown grace timeout does not authorize freeing GPU storage whose
+completion is unknown; the process must be restarted in that state.
+
+This placement does not provide predictive caching, cross-node execution or
+N:M routing. Moving a speculator to another GPU does not by itself overlap its
+computation with target verification or guarantee higher throughput.

+"""Placement compatibility policy: own-KV speculators with satisfiable

+        TargetFeatureKind.AUX_HIDDEN_STATES,
+    }
+)
+
+
+def make_capabilities(**overrides) -> SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities:
+    defaults = dict(
+        state_dependency="own_kv",
+        required_features=tuple(sorted(EAGLE3_FEATURES)),
+        standalone_weights="materializable",
+        supports_parallel_drafting=True,
+    )

+
+
+def test_own_kv_speculator_accepted():

+            parallel_drafting=True,
+            draft_sample_method="greedy",
+            provided_features=EAGLE3_FEATURES,
+        )
+        == []
+    )
+
+
+def test_target_kv_sharing_rejected():

+        make_capabilities(state_dependency="target_kv"),
+        parallel_drafting=False,
+        draft_sample_method="greedy",
+        provided_features=EAGLE3_FEATURES,

+    assert "target-owned state" in reasons[0]
+
+
+def test_missing_standalone_weights_rejected():

+        draft_sample_method="greedy",
+        provided_features={TargetFeatureKind.TOKEN_IDS},

+    frame_to_ints,
+    ints_to_frame,
+)

+VERIFIER = "verifier-a"
+NUM_SPEC_TOKENS = 4
+VOCAB = 50
+OK = SpeculatorStatusCode.OK

+def key(sequence_id: int, generation: int = 0, verifier: str = VERIFIER):

+        verifier_instance_id=verifier,
+        sequence_id=sequence_id,

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("operation", "retired_count"),
+    [
+        ("close", 0),
+        ("close", 1),
+        ("discard", 0),
+        ("discard", 1),
+        ("cleanup", 0),
+        ("cleanup", 1),
+        ("cleanup", 2),
+        ("replace", 0),
+        ("replace", 1),
+    ],
+)
+def test_retirement_failure_preserves_owners_and_fences_adapter(
+    operation, retired_count
+):
+    """Failed device retirement retains owners, closes the peer, and fences work."""
+    retirements = []
+
+    class FailingRetirementAdapter(FakeDraftAdapter):
+        def close_sequences(self, keys):
+            retirements.append(keys)
+            assert all(server.registry.get(sequence) is not None for sequence in keys)
+            super().close_sequences(keys[:retired_count])
+            raise MemoryError("injected block return failure")
+
+        def advance_and_propose(self, batch):
+            raise RuntimeError("injected adapter failure")
+
+    adapter = FailingRetirementAdapter(vocab_size=VOCAB)
+    server = RemoteDraftServer(adapter)
+    endpoint = server.start("tcp://127.0.0.1:0")
+    first, second = RawClient(endpoint), RawClient(endpoint)
+    owned, sibling, other = key(1), key(2), key(3)
+    expected = (owned,) if operation == "replace" else (owned, sibling)
+    try:
+        assert isinstance(first.hello(), HelloAck)
+        first.ready(owned)
+        first.ready(sibling)
+        assert isinstance(second.hello(), HelloAck)
+        second.ready(other)
+
+        with pytest.raises(ConnectionClosed):
+            if operation == "close":
+                first.send(CloseSequence((owned, sibling, other)))
+                first.recv()
+            elif operation == "discard":
+                first.propose(0, [owned, sibling, other], recovery=[4, 5, 6])
+            elif operation == "cleanup":
+                first.conn._sock.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
+                first.recv()
+            else:
+                first.open(key(1, generation=1))
+        assert server.wait(timeout=2)
+        assert retirements == [expected]
+        for sequence, owner in (
+            (owned, first.session_id),
+            (sibling, first.session_id),
+            (other, second.session_id),
+        ):
+            entry = server.registry.get(sequence)
+            assert entry is not None and entry.owner == owner
+            assert adapter.prefix(sequence) == (
+                None if sequence in expected[:retired_count] else [1, 2, 3]
+            )
+        assert server.registry.get(key(1, generation=1)) is None
+        assert adapter.prefix(key(1, generation=1)) is None
+
+        # Another live session cannot retry retirement or enter the failed adapter.
+        with pytest.raises(ConnectionClosed):
+            second.open(key(4))
+        server.stop()
+        with pytest.raises(server_module.SequenceCleanupFailed, match="restart"):
+            server.start("tcp://127.0.0.1:0")
+        assert retirements == [expected]
+        assert len(server.registry) == 3
+        assert server.queue_depth == 0
+    finally:
+        first.close()
+        second.close()
+        server.stop()

+def checksum(*frames) -> int:
+    value = 0
+    for frame in frames:
+        value = zlib.crc32(frame.payload, value)
+    return value & 0x7FFFFFFF
+
+
+class RawClient:
+    """Minimal verifier that speaks the protocol directly."""
+
+    def __init__(self, endpoint: str):
+        self.conn = connect(endpoint, timeout=5.0)
+        self.session_id = ""
+        self.request_id = 0
+        self.frames: dict[int, DataFrame] = {}
+        self.next_slot = 100
+
+    def send(self, message, *, frames=()):
+        for frame in frames:
+            self.conn.send_data(frame)
+        self.request_id += 1
+        self.conn.send_control(
+            encode_message(
+                message, session_id=self.session_id, request_id=self.request_id
+            )
+        )
+        return self.request_id
+
+    def recv(self, timeout: float = 5.0):
+        while True:
+            frame = self.conn.recv(timeout=timeout)
+            if frame.kind == FRAME_DATA:
+                data = decode_data_frame(frame.body)
+                self.frames[data.slot] = data
+                continue
+            envelope = decode_envelope(frame.body)
+            return envelope, decode_payload(envelope)
+
+    def call(self, message, *, frames=()):
+        request_id = self.send(message, frames=frames)
+        envelope, reply = self.recv()
+        assert envelope.request_id == request_id
+        return reply
+
+    def hello(self, **overrides) -> HelloAck:
+        fields = dict(
+            verifier_instance_id=VERIFIER,
+            target_fingerprint="tf",
+            tokenizer_fingerprint="kf",
+            method="eagle3",
+            num_speculative_tokens=NUM_SPEC_TOKENS,
+            parallel_drafting=False,
+            supported_transports=("inline",),
+        )
+        fields.update(overrides)
+        reply = self.call(Hello(**fields))
+        if isinstance(reply, HelloAck):
+            self.session_id = reply.session_id
+        return reply
+
+    def open(self, k: SequenceKey) -> SequenceAck:
+        return self.call(OpenSequence(key=k))
+
+    def prefill(
+        self,
+        k: SequenceKey,
+        tokens,
+        *,
+        offset: int,
+        is_final=True,
+        checksum_override=None,
+    ) -> SequenceAck:
+        slot = self.reserve(1)
+        frame = ints_to_frame(slot, tokens)
+        chunk = PrefillChunk(
+            key=k,
+            offset=offset,
+            num_tokens=len(tokens),
+            is_final=is_final,
+            feature_slot=slot,
+            checksum=checksum(frame)
+            if checksum_override is None
+            else checksum_override,
+        )
+        return self.call(chunk, frames=[frame])
+
+    def ready(self, k: SequenceKey, tokens=(1, 2, 3)) -> None:
+        assert self.open(k).status is OK
+        assert self.prefill(k, list(tokens), offset=0).status is OK
+
+    def propose(self, batch_id: int, keys, recovery, accepted=None):
+        accepted = accepted or [0] * len(keys)
+        base = self.reserve(3)
+        frames = [
+            ints_to_frame(base, accepted),
+            ints_to_frame(base + 1, recovery),
+            ints_to_frame(base + 2, recovery),
+        ]
+        message = AdvanceAndPropose(
+            batch_id=batch_id,
+            keys=tuple(keys),
+            accepted_counts_slot=base,
+            recovery_tokens_slot=base + 1,
+            feature_slot=base + 2,
+        )
+        return self.call(message, frames=frames)
+
+    def propose_with_frames(self, batch_id, keys, accepted, recovery, feature):
+        base = self.reserve(3)
+        frames = [
+            DataFrame(base, accepted.dtype, accepted.shape, accepted.payload),
+            DataFrame(base + 1, recovery.dtype, recovery.shape, recovery.payload),
+            DataFrame(base + 2, feature.dtype, feature.shape, feature.payload),
+        ]
+        return self.call(
+            AdvanceAndPropose(
+                batch_id=batch_id,
+                keys=tuple(keys),
+                accepted_counts_slot=base,
+                recovery_tokens_slot=base + 1,
+                feature_slot=base + 2,
+            ),
+            frames=frames,
+        )
+
+    def propose_ragged(self, batch_id, keys, query_lens, token_ids, *, lens=True):
+        base = self.reserve(4)
+        frames = [
+            ints_to_frame(base, [0] * len(keys)),
+            ints_to_frame(base + 1, [1] * len(keys)),
+            ints_to_frame(base + 3, token_ids),
+        ]
+        if lens:
+            frames.append(ints_to_frame(base + 2, query_lens))
+        return self.call(
+            AdvanceAndPropose(
+                batch_id=batch_id,
+                keys=tuple(keys),
+                accepted_counts_slot=base,
+                recovery_tokens_slot=base + 1,
+                feature_slot=base + 3,
+                query_lens_slot=base + 2,
+            ),
+            frames=frames,
+        )
+
+    def result(self, response: ProposalResponse):
+        base = response.result_slot
+        assert base is not None
+        tokens = self.frames.pop(base)
+        valid = self.frames.pop(base + 1)
+        statuses = self.frames.pop(base + 2)
+        rows = tokens.shape[0]
+        flat = frame_to_ints(tokens)
+        return (
+            [
+                flat[i * NUM_SPEC_TOKENS : (i + 1) * NUM_SPEC_TOKENS]
+                for i in range(rows)
+            ],
+            frame_to_ints(valid),
+            [SpeculatorStatusCode(s) for s in frame_to_ints(statuses)],
+        )
+
+    def reserve(self, count: int) -> int:
+        slot = self.next_slot
+        self.next_slot += count
+        return slot
+
+    def close(self):
+        self.conn.close()
+
+
+def expected_row(last_token: int):
+    return [(last_token + j + 1) % VOCAB for j in range(NUM_SPEC_TOKENS)]
+

+class MalformedResultAdapter(FakeDraftAdapter):
+    def __init__(self, mode: str):
+        super().__init__(vocab_size=VOCAB)
+        self.mode = mode
+
+    def advance_and_propose(
+        self, batch: StandaloneProposalBatch
+    ) -> StandaloneProposalResult:
+        result = super().advance_and_propose(batch)
+        if self.mode == "short_payload":
+            valid_lengths = DataFrame(0, "int32", (len(batch.keys),), b"")
+        else:
+            valid_lengths = ints_to_frame(
+                0, [batch.num_speculative_tokens + 1] * len(batch.keys)
+            )
+        return StandaloneProposalResult(
+            result.token_ids, valid_lengths, result.row_statuses
+        )

+def wait_until(predicate, timeout: float = 5.0) -> bool:
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("failure", ["queue_full", "adapter", "malformed_result"])
+def test_slow_error_reply_does_not_block_another_session_cleanup(
+    server, adapter, client, monkeypatch, failure
+):
+    client.hello()
+    failed_key = key(80)
+    if failure != "queue_full":
+        client.ready(failed_key)
+    other = RawClient(server.endpoint)
+    other.hello(verifier_instance_id="verifier-b")
+    other_key = key(81, verifier="verifier-b")
+    other.ready(other_key)
+    if failure == "queue_full":
+        server.limits = RemoteServerLimits(
+            max_batch_size=DEFAULT_LIMITS.max_batch_size,
+            max_feature_tokens=DEFAULT_LIMITS.max_feature_tokens,
+            max_sequences=1,
+            max_model_len=DEFAULT_LIMITS.max_model_len,
+        )
+    else:
+        propose = adapter.advance_and_propose
+
+        def fail_proposal(batch):
+            if failure == "adapter":
+                raise RuntimeError("injected adapter failure")
+            result = propose(batch)
+            return dataclasses.replace(result, valid_lengths=ints_to_frame(0, []))
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(adapter, "advance_and_propose", fail_proposal)
+
+    sending = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+    cleaned = threading.Event()
+    replies = []
+    errors = []
+    sendall = socket.socket.sendall
+    client_address = client.conn._sock.getsockname()
+
+    def slow_error_reply(sock, data, *args, **kwargs):
+        if sock.getpeername() == client_address:
+            sending.set()
+            if not release.wait(timeout=5.0):
+                raise TimeoutError("error reply was not released")
+        return sendall(sock, data, *args, **kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, "sendall", slow_error_reply)
+
+    def reject():
+        try:
+            replies.append(
+                client.open(failed_key)
+                if failure == "queue_full"
+                else client.propose(0, [failed_key], recovery=[1])
+            )
+        except Exception as error:
+            errors.append(error)
+
+    def cleanup():
+        try:
+            reply = other.call(CloseSequence(keys=(other_key,)))
+            assert reply.status is OK
+            cleaned.set()
+        except Exception as error:
+            errors.append(error)
+
+    rejected = threading.Thread(target=reject)
+    closing = threading.Thread(target=cleanup)
+    try:
+        rejected.start()
+        assert sending.wait(timeout=5.0)
+        if failure != "queue_full":
+            assert server.registry.get(failed_key) is None
+            assert adapter.prefix(failed_key) is None
+        closing.start()
+        assert cleaned.wait(timeout=2.0)
+        assert server.registry.get(other_key) is None
+        assert adapter.prefix(other_key) is None
+    finally:
+        release.set()
+        rejected.join(timeout=5.0)
+        if closing.ident is not None:
+            closing.join(timeout=5.0)
+        other.close()
+    assert not rejected.is_alive() and not closing.is_alive()
+    assert not errors
+    expected = (
+        SpeculatorStatusCode.QUEUE_FULL
+        if failure == "queue_full"
+        else SpeculatorStatusCode.INTERNAL_ERROR
+    )
+    assert len(replies) == 1 and replies[0].status is expected
+

+def batch(batch_id, keys, recovery, accepted=None):
+    accepted = accepted or [0] * len(keys)
+    return RemoteProposalBatch(
+        batch_id=batch_id,
+        keys=tuple(keys),
+        accepted_counts=tokens(accepted),
+        recovery_tokens=tokens(recovery, torch.int64),
+        features=features(recovery),

+class ProtocolPeer:
+    """Socket peer for replies a conforming draft adapter cannot produce."""
+
+    hello: Hello
+
+    def __init__(self, conn):
+        self.conn = conn
+
+    def recv(self):
+        frames = []
+        while True:
+            frame = self.conn.recv(timeout=5)
+            if frame.kind == transport_module.FRAME_DATA:
+                frames.append(transport_module.decode_data_frame(frame.body))
+                continue
+            envelope = decode_envelope(frame.body)
+            return envelope, decode_payload(envelope), frames
+
+    def reply(self, envelope, message, *, frames=()):
+        for frame in frames:
+            self.conn.send_data(frame)
+        self.conn.send_control(
+            encode_message(message, session_id="s", request_id=envelope.request_id)
+        )
+

+class PaddedAdapter(FakeDraftAdapter):
+    """Proposes one valid token per row and pads the rest with junk."""
+
+    def __init__(self, padding: int, first: int):
+        super().__init__(vocab_size=VOCAB)
+        self.padding = padding
+        self.first = first
+
+    def advance_and_propose(self, batch_):
+        result = super().advance_and_propose(batch_)
+        rows = len(batch_.keys)
+        row = [self.first] + [self.padding] * (NUM_SPEC_TOKENS - 1)
+        return dataclasses.replace(
+            result,
+            token_ids=tensor_to_frame(0, torch.tensor([row] * rows)),
+            valid_lengths=tensor_to_frame(0, torch.ones(rows, dtype=torch.int32)),
+        )

+def timeout_after_frames(monkeypatch, conn, completed_frames):
+    send_data = conn.send_data
+    sent = 0
+
+    def send(frame, *, deadline=None, drain_incoming=False):
+        nonlocal sent
+        if sent == completed_frames:
+            raise TransportTimeout("deadline elapsed before the next frame")
+        send_data(frame, deadline=deadline, drain_incoming=drain_incoming)
+        sent += 1
+
+    def reject_control(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise TransportTimeout("deadline elapsed before the control message")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(conn, "send_data", send)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(conn, "send_control", reject_control)
+

+"""Client-side lifecycle state machines: one-shot proposal handles and the
+recover/latch rules for remote sequences."""

+import pytest

+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.state import (
+    HandleState,

+    can_transition_sequence,

+
+def _walk_handle(*states: HandleState) -> HandleState:
+    current = states[0]
+    for new in states[1:]:
+        current = transition_handle(current, new)
+    return current
+
+
+def _walk_sequence(*states: SequenceState) -> SequenceState:
+    current = states[0]
+    for new in states[1:]:
+        current = transition_sequence(current, new)
+    return current
+
+
+def test_handle_happy_path():
+    assert (
+        _walk_handle(
+            HandleState.CREATED,
+            HandleState.DISPATCHED,
+            HandleState.COMPLETED,
+            HandleState.COLLECTED,
+        )
+        is HandleState.COLLECTED
+    )
+
+
+def test_handle_cannot_skip_dispatch():
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidStateTransition):
+        transition_handle(HandleState.CREATED, HandleState.COLLECTED)
+
+
+def test_timed_out_handle_is_still_collected_once():
+    state = _walk_handle(
+        HandleState.CREATED, HandleState.DISPATCHED, HandleState.TIMED_OUT
+    )
+    assert transition_handle(state, HandleState.COLLECTED) is HandleState.COLLECTED
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidStateTransition):
+        transition_handle(HandleState.TIMED_OUT, HandleState.COMPLETED)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("terminal", [HandleState.CANCELLED, HandleState.COLLECTED])
+def test_terminal_handle_states_reject_everything(terminal):
+    for new in HandleState:
+        with pytest.raises(InvalidStateTransition):
+            transition_handle(terminal, new)
+
+
+def test_sequence_main_path():
+    assert (
+        _walk_sequence(
+            SequenceState.OPENING,
+            SequenceState.PREFILLING,
+            SequenceState.READY,
+            SequenceState.IN_FLIGHT,
+            SequenceState.READY,
+            SequenceState.CLOSING,
+            SequenceState.CLOSED,
+        )
+        is SequenceState.CLOSED
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "state",
+    [
+        SequenceState.OPENING,
+        SequenceState.PREFILLING,
+        SequenceState.READY,
+        SequenceState.IN_FLIGHT,
+        SequenceState.DESYNCED,
+    ],
+)
+def test_live_sequence_can_always_close_invalidate_or_latch(state):
+    for new in (
+        SequenceState.CLOSING,
+        SequenceState.INVALID,
+        SequenceState.TARGET_ONLY,
+    ):
+        assert can_transition_sequence(state, new)

+def test_target_only_is_latched_until_close():
+    # The MVP never resumes remote proposals for a latched request.
+    for new in (
+        SequenceState.READY,
+        SequenceState.PREFILLING,
+        SequenceState.IN_FLIGHT,
+        SequenceState.DESYNCED,
+    ):
+        assert not can_transition_sequence(SequenceState.TARGET_ONLY, new)
+    assert can_transition_sequence(SequenceState.TARGET_ONLY, SequenceState.CLOSING)

+
+def test_desynced_recovers_only_through_prefill():
+    assert can_transition_sequence(SequenceState.DESYNCED, SequenceState.PREFILLING)
+    for new in (SequenceState.READY, SequenceState.IN_FLIGHT):
+        with pytest.raises(InvalidStateTransition):
+            transition_sequence(SequenceState.DESYNCED, new)

+
+def test_invalid_requires_reopen():
+    assert can_transition_sequence(SequenceState.INVALID, SequenceState.OPENING)
+    assert can_transition_sequence(SequenceState.INVALID, SequenceState.CLOSING)
+    for new in (SequenceState.PREFILLING, SequenceState.READY):
+        assert not can_transition_sequence(SequenceState.INVALID, new)

+def test_closed_is_terminal():
+    for new in SequenceState:
+        assert not can_transition_sequence(SequenceState.CLOSED, new)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("failure", ["connect", "timeout", "tune", "framing"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("close_fails", [False, True])
+def test_failed_connect_releases_socket_while_traceback_is_retained(
+    monkeypatch, tmp_path, failure, close_fails
+):
+    """Ownership transfers only after connection setup has completed."""
+    sockets, errors = [], []
+    listener = listen("tcp://127.0.0.1:0")
+
+    class FailingSocket(socket.socket):
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+            sockets.append(self)
+
+        def connect(self, address):
+            if failure == "timeout":
+                raise TimeoutError("injected connect timeout")
+            return super().connect(address)
+
+        def setsockopt(self, *args):
+            if failure == "tune" and args[:2] == (
+                socket.IPPROTO_TCP,
+                socket.TCP_NODELAY,
+            ):
+                raise OSError(errno.ENOBUFS, "injected tuning failure")
+            return super().setsockopt(*args)
+
+        def settimeout(self, timeout):
+            if failure == "framing" and timeout is None:
+                raise MemoryError("injected framing allocation failure")
+            return super().settimeout(timeout)
+
+        def close(self):
+            super().close()
+            if close_fails:
+                raise OSError(errno.EIO, "injected cleanup failure")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "socket", FailingSocket)
+    endpoint = (
+        f"unix://{tmp_path / 'absent.sock'}"
+        if failure in ("connect", "timeout")
+        else listener.endpoint
+    )
+    try:
+        for _ in range(2):
+            with pytest.raises((TransportError, MemoryError)) as caught:
+                connect(endpoint, timeout=1)
+            errors.append(caught.value)
+        assert len(errors) == len(sockets) == 2
+        assert all(sock.fileno() == -1 for sock in sockets)
+        if close_fails:
+            assert all(
+                any("injected cleanup failure" in note for note in error.__notes__)
+                for error in errors
+            )
+    finally:
+        for sock in sockets:
+            socket.SocketType.close(sock)
+        listener.close()
+

+def test_send_frames_share_absolute_deadline(monkeypatch):
+    now = [10.0]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(transport, "time", Mock(monotonic=lambda: now[0]))
+    sock, peer_sock = socket.socketpair()
+    sock.settimeout(1)
+    peer = FramedConnection(peer_sock)
+
+    class MeteredSocket:
+        """Charge virtual time per byte, independent of send coalescing."""
+
+        def settimeout(self, timeout):
+            self.remaining = timeout
+
+        def sendall(self, data):
+            available = len(data) if self.remaining is None else self.remaining
+            sent = min(len(data), int(available))
+            if sent:
+                sock.sendall(data[:sent])
+            now[0] += min(len(data), available)
+            if sent != len(data):
+                raise TimeoutError
+
+        def shutdown(self, how):
+            sock.shutdown(how)
+
+        def close(self):
+            sock.close()
+
+    connection = FramedConnection(MeteredSocket())
+    try:
+        deadline = 25.0
+        connection.send_control(b"first", deadline=deadline)
+        with pytest.raises(TransportTimeout):
+            connection.send_data(ints_to_frame(0, [1]), deadline=deadline)
+        assert now[0] == deadline
+        assert connection.closed
+        assert peer.recv(timeout=1).body == b"first"
+        with pytest.raises(ConnectionClosed):
+            peer.recv(timeout=1)
+    finally:
+        connection.close()
+        peer.close()

+    _, server = pair

+    def reader():

+        except BaseException as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - recorded for the assert
+            outcome.append(e)
+        else:
+            outcome.append(None)

+    thread = threading.Thread(target=reader)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", [FRAME_CONTROL, FRAME_DATA])
+def test_receive_rejects_oversized_header_before_body(kind):

+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Split-phase speculator proposal results.
+
+Splitting proposal generation into dispatch and collect lets a remote
+(dedicated-GPU) speculator overlap draft compute with target-side
+bookkeeping: dispatch returns a ProposalHandle that collect redeems for a
+SpeculatorOutput.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+
+
+@dataclass
+class SpeculatorOutput:
+    """Result of one proposal round.
+
+    ``valid_lengths`` decouples failure from token values: row ``i``
+    contributes ``token_ids[i, :valid_lengths[i]]`` draft tokens, and
+    ``valid_lengths[i] == 0`` means the request continues with target-only
+    decoding this round. Failures are never encoded as sentinel token IDs.
+    """
+
+    token_ids: torch.Tensor
+    """[batch, num_speculative_tokens] proposed draft token IDs."""
+    valid_lengths: torch.Tensor
+    """[batch] number of usable draft tokens per request."""
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        # Structural checks only; value-level checks would force a device
+        # sync on the hot path.
+        if self.token_ids.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"token_ids must be 2-D [batch, K], got {self.token_ids.ndim}-D"
+            )
+        if self.valid_lengths.ndim != 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"valid_lengths must be 1-D [batch], got {self.valid_lengths.ndim}-D"
+            )
+        if self.token_ids.shape[0] != self.valid_lengths.shape[0]:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"batch size mismatch: token_ids has {self.token_ids.shape[0]} "
+                f"rows, valid_lengths has {self.valid_lengths.shape[0]}"
+            )
+        for name, tensor in (
+            ("token_ids", self.token_ids),
+            ("valid_lengths", self.valid_lengths),
+        ):
+            if tensor.is_floating_point() or tensor.is_complex():
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must have an integer dtype")
+        if self.token_ids.device != self.valid_lengths.device:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"token_ids ({self.token_ids.device}) and valid_lengths "
+                f"({self.valid_lengths.device}) must be on the same device"
+            )
+
+
+class ProposalHandle:
+    """Opaque handle returned by dispatch, redeemed by collect."""

+  dispatch/collect, failure latching).

+  adapter contract, and a deterministic fake adapter for tests.
+
+Only ``session`` operates on tensors. The server, protocol, registry, and
+state logic exchange raw data-plane frames, so they need no GPU and can be
+unit tested in isolation.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Capability model for dedicated-device speculator placement.
+
+A speculator can only move to a dedicated GPU outside the target TP group
+when all of its runtime state can be reconstructed from transported target
+features (target-conditioned, own-KV). Compatibility is decided from an
+explicit capability object reported by the standalone server for the actual
+adapter and checkpoint, never from the speculative method name alone.
+"""
+
+import enum
+from collections.abc import Collection
+from typing import Literal
+
+import msgspec
+
+StateDependency = Literal["own_kv", "target_kv", "target_owned_state"]
+StandaloneWeights = Literal["complete", "materializable", "missing"]
+
+# Method families eligible for remote placement. This is a coarse
+# config-time gate only: MTP variant names are normalized to "mtp" before
+# validation, so variant- and checkpoint-level compatibility is enforced by
+# the capability report in the HELLO handshake, not by this set.
+REMOTE_DRAFT_SUPPORTED_METHODS = frozenset({"eagle", "eagle3", "mtp"})
+
+
+class TargetFeatureKind(str, enum.Enum):
+    """Target-side features a speculator may require every round."""
+
+    TOKEN_IDS = "token_ids"
+    POSITIONS = "positions"
+    QUERY_LENS = "query_lens"
+    LAST_HIDDEN_STATES = "last_hidden_states"
+    AUX_HIDDEN_STATES = "aux_hidden_states"
+    NEXT_PREFILL_TOKENS = "next_prefill_tokens"
+    NUM_SAMPLED_TOKENS = "num_sampled_tokens"
+    NUM_REJECTED_TOKENS = "num_rejected_tokens"
+    TEMPERATURE = "temperature"
+    SEEDS = "seeds"
+    TARGET_TOPK_INDICES = "target_topk_indices"
+
+
+class SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    """What a concrete speculator adapter and checkpoint support.
+
+    Reported by the standalone server during the HELLO handshake. The
+    verifier compares this against its own configuration and the features it
+    can provide, and rejects the connection with an explicit error instead
+    of silently running an unsupported combination.
+
+    Feature kinds are carried as plain strings (TargetFeatureKind values) so
+    that a newer-minor peer advertising an unknown kind stays decodable and
+    is rejected through `placement_incompatibilities` rather than failing
+    with a codec error.
+    """
+
+    state_dependency: StateDependency
+    required_features: tuple[str, ...]
+    num_prefill_lookahead: int = 0
+    """Lookahead tokens the adapter needs per prefill chunk; negotiation
+    input for the prefill-chunk contract, not a reject gate."""
+    supports_parallel_drafting: bool = False
+    supports_multi_module: bool = False
+    standalone_weights: StandaloneWeights = "missing"
+    supports_probabilistic_draft: bool = False
+
+
+def _feature_value(kind: str) -> str:
+    return kind.value if isinstance(kind, TargetFeatureKind) else kind
+
+
+def placement_incompatibilities(
+    capabilities: SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities,
+    *,
+    parallel_drafting: bool,
+    draft_sample_method: str,
+    provided_features: Collection[str],
+    uses_multi_module: bool = False,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Return reasons why a negotiated placement is unsupported.
+
+    An empty list means the verifier may use the remote speculator. Each
+    entry is a human-readable reason suitable for a startup error message.
+    ``provided_features`` accepts TargetFeatureKind members or their string
+    values.
+    """
+    reasons: list[str] = []
+    if capabilities.state_dependency != "own_kv":
+        reasons.append(
+            "the speculator depends on target-owned state "
+            f"({capabilities.state_dependency!r}) that cannot be transported "
+            "to a dedicated device; only own-KV speculators are supported"
+        )
+    if capabilities.standalone_weights == "missing":
+        reasons.append(
+            "the draft checkpoint does not provide the weights required to "
+            "materialize the speculator in a standalone process (e.g. "
+            "embedding or LM head shared with the target)"
+        )
+    provided = {_feature_value(f) for f in provided_features}
+    missing = [
+        _feature_value(f)
+        for f in capabilities.required_features
+        if _feature_value(f) not in provided
+    ]
+    if missing:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"the verifier cannot provide required target features: {sorted(missing)}"
+        )
+    if parallel_drafting and not capabilities.supports_parallel_drafting:
+        reasons.append(
+            "parallel_drafting is enabled but the speculator checkpoint does "
+            "not support parallel drafting"
+        )
+    if uses_multi_module and not capabilities.supports_multi_module:
+        reasons.append(
+            "the draft checkpoint uses multiple speculative modules but the "
+            "speculator does not support multi-module drafting"
+        )
+    if (
+        draft_sample_method != "greedy"
+        and not capabilities.supports_probabilistic_draft
+    ):
+        reasons.append(
+            f"draft_sample_method={draft_sample_method!r} requires a draft "
+            "probability contract that the remote speculator does not "
+            "implement; only greedy draft sampling is supported"
+        )
+    return reasons
+
+
+def remote_draft_config_incompatibilities(
+    *,
+    method: str | None,
+    draft_tensor_parallel_size: int | None,
+    draft_sample_method: str,
+    uses_target_kv: bool | None,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Return reasons why a SpeculativeConfig cannot use remote_draft.
+
+    This is the config-time subset of the compatibility policy: everything
+    that can be decided before connecting to the standalone server. The
+    remaining checks (checkpoint capabilities, feature schema, fingerprints)
+    happen during the HELLO handshake via `placement_incompatibilities`.
+    ``uses_target_kv=None`` means the property could not be determined and
+    is rejected fail-closed.
+    """
+    reasons: list[str] = []
+    if method not in REMOTE_DRAFT_SUPPORTED_METHODS:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"method {method!r} is not supported with remote_draft; "
+            f"supported methods: {sorted(REMOTE_DRAFT_SUPPORTED_METHODS)}"
+        )
+    if uses_target_kv is None:
+        reasons.append(
+            "cannot determine whether the draft model shares the target KV "
+            "cache (draft model config is not resolved)"
+        )
+    elif uses_target_kv:
+        reasons.append(
+            "the speculator shares the target KV cache directly and cannot "
+            "run on a dedicated device"
+        )
+    if draft_tensor_parallel_size is not None and draft_tensor_parallel_size > 1:
+        reasons.append(
+            "remote_draft requires draft_tensor_parallel_size=1; got "
+            f"{draft_tensor_parallel_size}"
+        )
+    # Blanket config-time restriction; relax together with the
+    # supports_probabilistic_draft gate in placement_incompatibilities.
+    if draft_sample_method != "greedy":
+        reasons.append(
+            "remote_draft currently requires draft_sample_method='greedy'; "
+            f"got {draft_sample_method!r}"
+        )
+    return reasons

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Control-plane wire protocol for the standalone speculator server.
+
+The control plane carries small, low-frequency messages (handshake,
+sequence lifecycle, health, errors). High-frequency tensor traffic (target
+features, draft tokens) travels on a separate data plane and is referenced
+from these messages only by slot index.
+
+Versioning rules:
+- A different ``protocol_major`` rejects the connection.
+- ``protocol_minor`` bumps may only add optional fields; unknown fields are
+  ignored on decode.
+- The envelope is the single authority for the protocol version; payloads
+  never carry their own copy.
+"""
+
+import enum
+from typing import Annotated
+
+import msgspec
+
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.capabilities import (
+    SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities,
+)
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.transport import TransportError, check_data_frame_size
+
+PROTOCOL_MAJOR = 1
+PROTOCOL_MINOR = 0
+
+# Field-level range constraints are enforced by msgspec on decode, so a
+# peer cannot deliver negative identifiers or degenerate shapes. Checks
+# that need negotiated session state (slot ranges, batch limits, schema
+# identity) belong to the session layer, not this module.
+NonNegativeInt = Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=0)]
+PositiveInt = Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(gt=0)]
+
+
+class ProtocolError(Exception):
+    """Malformed or incompatible control-plane message."""
+
+
+class ProtocolVersionError(ProtocolError):
+    """Peer speaks an incompatible protocol major version."""
+
+
+class SpeculatorStatusCode(enum.IntEnum):
+    """Per-batch / per-row status codes.
+
+    Failures are never encoded as token IDs; a failed row reports a status
+    here and ``valid_length=0`` so the verifier falls back to target-only
+    decoding for that request.
+    """
+
+    OK = 0
+    QUEUE_FULL = 1
+    TIMEOUT = 2
+    STALE_GENERATION = 3
+    ROUND_MISMATCH = 4
+    SEQUENCE_DESYNC = 5
+    UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE = 6
+    OUT_OF_MEMORY = 7
+    INTERNAL_ERROR = 8
+    PROTOCOL_ERROR = 9
+
+
+class SequenceKey(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    """Identity of one draft sequence's state on the server.
+
+    ``generation`` increments whenever the verifier re-creates state for the
+    same request (e.g. after preemption and re-prefill); responses carrying
+    an older generation are discarded as stale.
+    """
+
+    verifier_instance_id: str
+    sequence_id: NonNegativeInt
+    generation: NonNegativeInt
+
+
+class FeatureSlot(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    """One tensor slot in the negotiated target-feature layout.
+
+    ``kind`` is a TargetFeatureKind value carried as a plain string so that
+    unknown kinds from a newer-minor peer stay decodable.
+    """
+
+    kind: str
+    dtype: str
+    trailing_shape: tuple[PositiveInt, ...]
+    optional: bool = False
+    per_sequence: bool = False
+    """One row per sequence (e.g. temperature) instead of one row per
+    target token (e.g. hidden states)."""
+
+
+class TargetFeatureSchema(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    """Fixed slot ordering negotiated at handshake.
+
+    After the handshake the data plane only ever refers to this layout by
+    ``schema_id``; per-round messages never carry string feature maps.
+    """
+
+    schema_id: NonNegativeInt
+    slots: tuple[FeatureSlot, ...]
+
+
+class RemoteServerLimits(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    """Hard limits the server enforces.
+
+    Both peers reject the session at handshake when these cannot hold the
+    verifier's declared scheduler limits (see Hello).
+    """
+
+    max_batch_size: PositiveInt
+    max_feature_tokens: PositiveInt
+    max_sequences: PositiveInt
+    max_model_len: PositiveInt

+                SpeculatorStatusCode.SEQUENCE_DESYNC,
